'''2005 Endor Regional''' was a Star Wars CCG regional played on 23 October 2004 at Addictive Behaviors, 26 East 11th Ave, Eugene, Oregon. It was the main event of the 2005 Endor Regional Weekend (22–24 October 2004), run by [[David Kangas]] as Endor Flight Leader, and a qualifier for the [[2005 World Championship]]: the top two players each received a bye into Day 2, and first place won the chance to design a future Virtual Card.<ref name="pc-endor04">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Endor_Regional_2004.htm From Rebels to Mavericks: 2005 Endor Regional Weekend], swccgpc.com (October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041216041335/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Endor_Regional_2004.htm Internet Archive]</ref> [[John Hawkins]] won.<ref name="pcf-4063">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=4063 State of the PC Address: So long and thanks for all the fish], David Kangas, Player's Committee Forums, swccgpc.com (25 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041216005232/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=4063%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> The Day 2 byes went to John Hawkins and [[James Sheldon]], and Hawkins won the Virtual Card design.<ref name="pc-events05">[http://swccgpc.com/events.htm 2004/2005 Events: SWCCG 2005 Worlds Qualifiers Listing], swccgpc.com (updated 27 June 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050828001521/http://swccgpc.com:80/events.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Addictive Behaviors, 26 East 11th Ave, Eugene, Oregon<ref name="pc-endor04" />
* '''Dates:''' 23 October 2004, 1:00 PM<ref name="pc-endor04" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $10 (to be lowered depending on the number of participants)<ref name="pc-endor04" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[David Kangas]], Endor Flight Leader<ref name="pc-endor04" />
* '''Prizes:''' prizes for everybody, including uncut sheets, tournament foils and product; Day 2 byes to the top two players; a future Virtual Card design for first place<ref name="pc-endor04" />
* '''Winner:''' [[John Hawkins]]<ref name="pcf-4063" />
* '''Day 2 byes:''' [[John Hawkins]], [[James Sheldon]]<ref name="pc-events05" />

== Side events ==

The weekend opened on Friday 22 October with the store's first sanctioned [[WARS TCG]] booster draft ($10 for four packs), and a Star Wars CCG sealed or booster draft was offered that evening if enough players were interested. Saturday had further WARS TCG booster drafts at 12:30 PM and 5:00 PM and a Star Wars CCG "Super Secret Squirrel" draft at 7:15 PM. Sunday 24 October had a WARS TCG booster draft at 12:30 PM, a Star Wars CCG [[Booster Draft]] at 2:00 PM and a WARS TCG constructed event at 4:30 PM ($5; first place won a Gen Con exclusive WARS TCG Presentation T-shirt).<ref name="pc-endor04" />
